body:
This was a spontaneous combination and one thing led to the next. I'm experienced with tripping and my favorites are DMT, 2C-E, Ketamine, and pure LSD.
Smoked DPT is one of my favorite of all time visual psychedelics but only when combined with Ketamine. On this particular morning I felt the urge to slowly administer 100 mgs of Ketamine rectally. After letting the Ketamine fully absorb anally I then parachuted 15 mgs of 4-AcO-DMT. I really wanted to watch Interstellar so I popped in the bluray and sank giddyishly into the sofa. I enjoy combining Ketamine and 4-AcO-DMT because when mixed together their effects magnify immensely.
The movie was 3 hours long so I was taking my time and anticipating how strong the visuals would be. After about 1 hour into the movie the visuals began to really show off. The faces of characters in the movie were so trippy looking. The visuals were already at a +3 after only an hour and a half. I began to wonder if I should turn off the movie and look at psychedelic art instead. I paused the movie and proceeded to take 200 mgs Ketamine rectally. At this point I had zero anxiety and lots of mosaic patterns everywhere I looked.
Suddenly 30 minutes later, I felt the Ketamine all at once. I was getting dressed and going to watch the rest of the movie. As I walked back to the TV to unpause the movie I realized the Ketamine was completely distracting me but I sat and finished the rest of the movie. 3 and 1/2 hours had passed at this point and I was nodding from the Ketamine and the visuals weren't impressing me anymore. Instead of taking a booster dose of 4-AcO-DMT to bring back the visuals, I decided on DPT.
When placed on top of tin foil the DPT hydrochloride is vaporized and inhaled via a straw. This is my preferred way to smoke DPT. I've never had to convert it to freebase in order to smoke it. Over the course of the next 40 minutes I smoked 50 mgs, taking my time. I felt like with each toke, I was having my morning coffee. When I had finished the DPT the visuals were like nothing I've seen. The lines in my skin were swirling around. Vivid hallucinations occurred. My skin was twirling around and it looked so organic like it was really happening. Visuals never looked so natural like these. Kaleidoscope visuals are mellow and twirling at a medium speed. But it appeared to be really happening. Objects weren't distorted. Things were melting as clearly as watching something melt while being sober. There was no anxiety either. This lasted 1 hour and then I fell asleep. Walls and objects still breathed a little for the next few days.
In conclusion, taking Ketamine rectally, and smoking DPT are like two peas in a pod. The synergy is perfect, I don't have any of the negative DPT side effects. There's nothing but pure light. DPT showed me things I didn't even know about myself. I guess that's why they call it the light.
